name: Network Requests & Downloader Suite (Network & Downloader)
description: Provides HTTP REST requests, high-speed file downloading, WebSocket streaming, network probing, and P2P distribution

BtDownload.description: Download network resources via BitTorrent torrent files or magnet links

BtSeed.description: Seed and distribute local files across BitTorrent swarm

DomainQuery.description: Query DNS servers to resolve hostnames to IP addresses and records

ForwardProxy.description: Launch high-performance local forward proxy server with authentication support

HttpDownload.description: Download remote file over HTTP/HTTPS with timeout and overwrite options

HttpGet.description: Send standard HTTP GET request and retrieve response body and headers

HttpHead.description: Send HTTP HEAD request to check resource headers without downloading body

HttpPost.description: Send HTTP POST request with payload (JSON, form data, or raw text)

HttpRequest.description: Full-featured HTTP client supporting custom methods, file uploads, retries, and proxy

HttpWebhook.description: Listen for incoming Webhook notifications and trigger automation workflows

NetworkClose.description: Safely close open TCP/UDP sockets, tunnels, or connection pool handles

NetworkConnect.description: Connect to remote host via TCP or UDP and register connection in pool

NetworkListen.description: Bind and listen on local TCP/UDP port for incoming network packets

NetworkPing.description: Probe round-trip latency (RTT) and reachability to target host

NetworkReceive.description: Read incoming byte streams or packets from active socket connection

NetworkSend.description: Write and send binary bytes or text packets over active socket

P2PHost.description: Participate in decentralized P2P swarm to transfer files directly between peers

P2PServer.description: Start P2P peer discovery and NAT traversal signaling rendezvous server

PortCheck.description: Probe whether a remote TCP/UDP port is open, closed, or firewalled

ReceiveInput.description: Receive serialized keyboard and mouse input events from remote machine

SendEmail.description: Send emails with HTML body and attachments via secure SMTP protocol

SendInput.description: Serialize and send local keyboard/mouse input events to remote host

VideoDownload.description: Parse and download HLS/M3U8 or stream video segments into single MP4 file

WebSocketConnect.description: Establish full-duplex persistent WebSocket connection to server

WebSocketReceive.description: Wait and receive incoming message frame from WebSocket channel

WebSocketSend.description: Send text or JSON message immediately across WebSocket channel
